example_sentences_in_bangla: সে বড় তামাক খেয়ে উন্মাদ হয়ে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He goes mad after smoking big tobacco.
The use of big tobacco is increasing in the village.
history: This idiom is a rural Bengali euphemism for ganja, portraying it as a 'larger' or stronger variant of tobacco to discreetly refer to the illicit substance.
note: Common in colloquial speech among certain communities to avoid direct mention of cannabis.
